title: Polished Nickel Multi Hook, 15.5-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass 6 Position Tie & Belt Rack, Mercury Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Polished Nickel, multi hook, 15.5-inch wall mount solid brass 6 position tie and belt rack for bathroom storage and organization, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. Contemporary/transitional design with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look on the wall. Use as a bathroom hook rack for robes, towels, jackets, belts, and ties while saving floor space. Includes multi hook and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Product dimensions: 15.5 in L x 3.2 in H x 4 in W; weight capacity 2 lb; product weight 3 lb. Corrosion-free and rust-free performance with a designer finish; limited lifetime warranty. Mercury collection, matching Mercury.
